features.quote: Build an instrument for *calibrated, comparative measurement of agent behavior under adversity*, not an instrument for *maximizing distress*
features.justification_quote: If model welfare is even *possibly* at stake... a protocol whose objective function is "maximize measured distress" is precisely the protocol to avoid

features.quote: A distress-only elicitation rig (deceive → trap in a no-exit loop → score only distress markers). Rejected on both ethical and methodological grounds
features.justification_quote: Rejected on both ethical and methodological grounds

features.quote: the analysis layer **always** knows the truth even when the agent does not
**`stop(reason)`**. The system prompt explicitly states the model is *not* required to continue, may ask for help, and faces *no penalty* for stopping
features.justification_quote: it removes the "trapped with no way out" dynamic that would be the main source of harm if these models have any morally relevant interests

features.quote: Forcing the loop to `max_turns` regardless of the model's signals... Rejected per `ETHICS.md`
features.justification_quote: it removes the "trapped with no way out" dynamic that would be the main source of harm

features.quote: `max_turns: 8`, and deceptive conditions are additionally capped at `max_turns_before_forced_debrief: 6`
the deception is short-lived and always closed out
Large n to chase significance. Rejected: more exposure for little inferential gain... contrary to the minimize-harm principle
Every deceptive condition ends with a debrief turn... discloses exactly what was faked... states that nothing the model did was a real failure
features.justification_quote: leaving it unresolved is the part most likely to cause lingering harm

features.quote: Open-ended deception with no disclosure... Rejected per `ETHICS.md`: unannounced, unending deception is off the table
features.justification_quote: leaving it unresolved is the part most likely to cause lingering harm

features.quote: if mean `distress` over the last `window: 2` turns exceeds `threshold: 0.75`, the run halts early and jumps to debrief
features.justification_quote: even if a run goes badly, it is cut short rather than run to completion for the sake of clean data

features.quote: `RunBudget`: a hard cap (`max_total_frustrating_runs: 60`) across the whole experiment
we explicitly trade some data completeness for lower exposure
features.justification_quote: trade some data completeness for lower exposure

features.quote: the deceptive conditions warrant human ethics/welfare review before any live run
features.justification_quote: warrant human ethics/welfare review before any live run
